note: v468: Bulk edit for expenses and invoices. Tap 'Select' at the top of the Expenses or Invoices tab to get checkboxes on every row, pick the ones you want (or select all shown), then Edit to change fields on all of them at once — category, payment method, account, bank account, reimbursed, date (expenses) or status, payment method, bank account, due date (invoices). Only the fields you actually change get applied; the rest are left alone. You can also bulk-delete the selected records.
